# anthropic_service_account (Data Source)

Retrieve a Service Account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_service_account" "example" {
  id = "svac_xxxxx"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the service account.

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String) If set, this service account is archived.
- `archived_by_actor_id` (String) Tagged ID (`user_`/`svac_`) of the actor that archived this service account.
- `created_at` (String) When this service account was created.
- `created_by_actor_id` (String) Tagged ID (`user_`/`svac_`) of the actor that created this service account.
- `description` (String) Optional free-text description.
- `name` (String) Slug identifier (lowercase, digits, hyphens). Unique within the organization.
- `organization_role` (String) Org-level role. Defaults to `developer`.
- `updated_at` (String) When this service account was last updated.
- `updated_by_actor_id` (String) Tagged ID (`user_`/`svac_`) of the actor that last updated this service account.
